name: Date Calculator
description: Days between two dates, adding days, weeks or working days to a date, and your exact age with your next birthday.
prompt: A date calculator with three tabs: the days, weeks, working days and weekends between two dates; adding or subtracting days, weeks, months, years or working days from a date; and your exact age with the day you were born and your next birthday.
author: gonzaroman

description_i18n.es: Días entre dos fechas, sumar días, semanas o días laborables a una fecha, y tu edad exacta con tu próximo cumpleaños.
